question: Does smaller standardized expert-logit change after mild sequential JPEG recompression predict lower original per-image expert loss on generators excluded from expert training and scale estimation?
scope: Exploratory development validation on previously inspected generators; no new blind final test, no new expert or gate fitting.
experts: Frozen Round8 A matched global/local heads and original CLIP weights, preprocessing and four shuffle seeds.

extraction.order: Original -> existing current-condition 224px image -> JPEG95 encode/decode on that current image -> global view and same four shuffled views. Baseline and probe encoded in matching batch order/shapes. No resize between current image and probe.

normalization: For each data seed, sigma_global/local are population standard deviations (ddof=0) of existing original-view logits on that seed's source_only gate_fit Real250+SD15250, pooled over clean/jpeg70/resize05. No centering, per-label/condition rescaling, target statistics or calibration fitting. Nonfinite or zero scale is an error.
primary_signal: S = abs(z_local_probe-z_local_base)/sigma_local - abs(z_global_probe-z_global_base)/sigma_global. S>0 predicts global is more reliable; direction will not be reversed after inspection.
primary_target: R=1 when (2*y-1)*(z_global_base-z_local_base)>0, equivalent to lower original global BCE. Exact equality is excluded with counts; this is relative loss, not necessarily correct classification.
primary_metric: AUROC(S,R) computed separately by seed, generator/class group (Real, ADM, BigGAN) and condition. Within condition/seed use weights Real=.5, ADM=.25, BigGAN=.25; then equal average of four conditions and three data seeds. No pooled-label AUROC substitutes for this endpoint.
reference: Same relative-loss AUROC using each of the three frozen source_only score_gate AUROC-checkpoint alpha values on fresh baseline inputs; average metrics across gate initializations inside each data seed. No new probe model or feature selection.
secondary_rules: All signals reported with fixed direction; no choosing a winning transform, sign or condition. Source-only tuning results are controls, not used to refit or tune.
classification_check: Use frozen source_only per-expert thresholds. Among images on which exactly one original expert is correct, choose global for S>0, local for S<0, expected half credit for S=0. Report coverage, selection accuracy, always-global/local controls, and whole-sample expected accuracy/BA. Separately report selected original-logit AUROC (S=0 uses mean logit, not a random expert draw) and average fusion as descriptive diagnostics, with no new threshold selection.
bootstrap: 1000 paired original-image resamples, seed 20261108; within Real/ADM/BigGAN groups, same identity multiplicities across four conditions, models and three seeds; shared Real counted once with .5 weight. Conditional on fitted experts and source scales. No multiplicity-adjusted claims for secondary signals.
nonestimable: If either relative-loss winner is absent in a prescribed cell, mark AUROC unavailable, report counts and do not silently renormalize macro or claim full success. Report any undefined bootstrap draws; no unreported removal of cells.

decision.supported_signal: Primary macro 95% conditional interval lower bound > .5, with ADM fake macro, BigGAN fake macro and JPEG70/JPEG50 pooled primary-weight macro each > .5. This supports a relative-loss signal, not improved image detection or incremental value beyond existing scores.
decision.uncertain: Primary point estimate > .5 but interval overlaps .5 or required generator/JPEG directions disagree.
decision.unsupported: Primary point estimate <= .5, or apparent association vanishes under required class/condition stratification.
decision.added_value: Report paired primary AUROC difference from existing score_gate reference separately. Even a positive difference is a stand-alone signal comparison, not proof of incremental information conditional on all existing inputs. Classification usefulness additionally requires the locked routing checks.

exclusions: No final/reserved image/manifests/scores, no recompression-quality sweep, no sign selection, no retraining, no new gate, no treating old independent JPEG70 and JPEG50 caches as sequential recompression.
freeze: Frozen before full paired extraction and before any probe outcome inspection.
